description: This file defines the 'DeleteFeaturePropertiesStrategy' class, a specific implementation of a command handling strategy for deleting feature properties within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It processes 'DeleteFeatureProperties' commands, extracts the relevant feature from a Thing, and generates appropriate events and responses to signify the deletion of feature properties.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class implementing a command strategy to handle deletion of feature properties in a Thing.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete feature properties command, resulting in either a successful event and response or an error if the feature is not found.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specified feature from a Thing based on the command.

methods.name: getDeleteFeaturePropertiesResult
methods.description: Creates the result object after successfully deleting feature properties, including the event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the previous entity state related to the feature for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, indicating no specific entity tag for the new state after deletion.
